InvitationAccept.title: InvitationAccept
InvitationAccept.description:
API model for accepting a fleet invitation

Optional data that fleets can provide when accepting an invitation.
These fields supplement or override partner-provided values.

fleet_ref.title: Fleet Reference
fleet_ref.description: Your internal fleet identifier. Use this to map Catena fleets back to your system. This value will be returned in webhooks and redirect URLs. Only letters, numbers, spaces, dashes, and underscores are allowed.

partner_provided_fleet_name.title: Fleet Name
partner_provided_fleet_name.description: Pre-populate the fleet name during onboarding. The fleet can modify this during acceptance. Only letters, numbers, and spaces are allowed.

partner_provided_fleet_email.title: Fleet Email
partner_provided_fleet_email.description: Pre-populate the fleet contact email. Optional but recommended for faster onboarding.

partner_provided_fleet_regulatory_id.title: Fleet Regulatory ID
partner_provided_fleet_regulatory_id.description: Pre-populate the fleet's regulatory identifier (e.g., DOT number, EASA ID). Helps with fleet verification.

partner_provided_fleet_regulatory_id_typ.title: Fleet Regulatory ID Type
partner_provided_fleet_regulatory_id_typ.description: Pre-populate the type of regulatory ID provided (e.g., DOT, EASA, MC). Required if regulatory_id is set.

partner_provided_fleet_phone.title: Fleet Phone
partner_provided_fleet_phone.description: Pre-populate the phone number of the fleet

partner_provided_fleet_website.title: Fleet website
partner_provided_fleet_website.description: Pre-populate the website of the fleet

partner_provided_fleet_country_code.title: Fleet Country Code
partner_provided_fleet_country_code.description: Pre-populate the country code of the fleet

success_redirect_url.title: Success Redirect URL
success_redirect_url.description: The URL to redirect the user to after onboarding successfully on Catena Connect. **Available query parameters:** `invitation_id`, `fleet_ref`.

failure_redirect_url.title: Failure Redirect URL
failure_redirect_url.description: The URL to redirect the user to after failing to onboard on Catena Connect (i.e. declining an invitation, opening an expired invitation, etc). **Available query parameters:** `invitation_id`, `fleet_ref`.

callback_url.title: Callback URL
callback_url.description: Your webhook endpoint to receive real-time notifications for invitation acceptance, share agreement creation, and connection status updates. Must be HTTPS.

limit_tsps.title: Limit TSPs
limit_tsps.description: Restrict which telematics providers the fleet can connect to. Useful if you only need data from specific TSPs. If omitted, all available TSPs are shown.

expires_in_hours.title: Expires In Hours
expires_in_hours.description: How long the invitation link remains valid (1-672 hours). Default is 24 hours. *Consider longer durations for email campaigns.*

InvitationCreate.title: InvitationCreate
InvitationCreate.description: API model for creating a fleet invitation

decline_reason.title: Decline Reason
decline_reason.description: Reason for declining the invitation (e.g., 'Not interested', 'Already using another service')

InvitationDecline.title: InvitationDecline
InvitationDecline.description:
API model for declining a fleet invitation

Optional data that fleets can provide when declining an invitation.
Helps partners understand why invitations were rejected.

magic_link.title: Magic Link
magic_link.description: The magic link that is used to open Catena Connect and accept the invitation. Share this URL with the fleet to begin onboarding.

expires_at.title: Invitation Expiration
expires_at.description: The expiration date and time of the invitation

expires_in_hours.title: Expires In Hours
expires_in_hours.description: The number of hours the invitation is valid for.

status.title: Status
status.description: The current status of the invitation (ACTIVE, ACCEPTED, DECLINED, or EXPIRED)

partner_provided_fleet_name.title: Fleet Name
partner_provided_fleet_name.description: Pre-populate the fleet name during onboarding. The fleet can modify this during acceptance.

accepted_at.title: Accepted At
accepted_at.description: The date and time the invitation was accepted. Null if not accepted.

pre_registration_access_token.title: Pre-Registration JWT Token
pre_registration_access_token.description: The JWT token used to pre-register the fleet. It allows the fleet to create connections after accepting the invitation even without registering a user. Value is set after the invitation is accepted.

pre_registration_refresh_token.title: Pre-Registration Refresh Token
pre_registration_refresh_token.description: The refresh token used to pre-register the fleet. It allows the fleet to create connections after accepting the invitation even without registering a user. Value is set after the invitation is accepted.

callback_url.title: Callback URL
callback_url.description: Your webhook endpoint to receive real-time notifications for invitation acceptance, share agreement creation, and connection status updates. Must be HTTPS.

success_redirect_url.title: Success Redirect URL
success_redirect_url.description: The URL to redirect the user to after onboarding successfully on Catena Connect. **Available query parameters:** `invitation_id`, `fleet_ref`.

failure_redirect_url.title: Failure Redirect URL
failure_redirect_url.description: The URL to redirect the user to after failing to onboard on Catena Connect (i.e. declining an invitation, opening an expired invitation, etc). **Available query parameters:** `invitation_id`, `fleet_ref`.

limit_tsps.title: Limit TSPs
limit_tsps.description: Restrict which telematics providers the fleet can connect to. Useful if you only need data from specific TSPs. If omitted, all available TSPs are shown.

fleet_id.title: Fleet ID
fleet_id.description: The Catena fleet ID created after accepting the invitation. Null if invitation has not been accepted.

partner_id.title: Partner ID
partner_id.description: Your organization ID requesting access to fleet data

decline_reason.title: Decline Reason
decline_reason.description: The reason provided by the fleet for declining the invitation. Null if invitation was not declined.

declined_at.title: Declined At
declined_at.description: The date the invitation was declined by the fleet. Null if invitation was not declined.

fleet_ref.title: Fleet Reference
fleet_ref.description: Your internal fleet identifier. Use this to map Catena fleets back to your system. This value will be returned in webhooks and redirect URLs.

InvitationRead.title: InvitationRead
InvitationRead.description:
API model for reading a fleet invitation

Contains the complete invitation state including acceptance/decline status.
Use this to track invitation lifecycle and retrieve tokens for accepted invitations.
